text:
Carla S: Heads-up: we have a planned runtime rollout for hosted inference (runtime v2.7.0 -> v2.7.1) tomorrow 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Minimal customer impact expected, brief cache warmup, possible 5-10s cold-starts for long-context sessions. Need statuspage + customer email copy.

Jonah P: thanks. what's the allowed change window? any regional exceptions?

Carla S: window is global 02:00-03:00 UTC. APAC ops asked to avoid 02:30-02:50 for an enterprise migration — so we'll keep the middle 20m as low-risk fallback (i.e., stagger canaries regionally).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: job-id=deploy-2026-03-21-02-00, targets=hosted-api, canary=10%, rollout=30m canary + 30m ramp. Notifying oncall.

Ayesha (oncall): I'm on it. Can we publish a status page 'maintenance' with 'partial impact' and an ETA? Keep wording conservative.

Liz Product: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb. We should include: start/end UTC, impacted features (text gen API, streaming may be briefly throttled), and mitigation (auto-fallback to compatible model variant). Also note no data loss.

Carla S: good. also include support contact and link to live status.

Jonah P: here's a short status page snippet you can copy:

```
Title: Scheduled maintenance — inference runtime upgrade
Status: Maintenance
Start: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC (est)
Impact: Brief increased latency and occasional 5-10s cold-starts for some long-context requests. No data loss. Automatic fallback to stable model variants will be applied if errors increase.
What we're doing: Rolling upgrade of hosted inference runtime (v2.7.0 -> v2.7.1) to improve batching and KV cache stability.
Contact: support@redwood.ai | status.redwood.ai
```

Carla S: nice. can you also draft an email subject + 2-line body for customers who opt in for maintenance notices?

Jonah P: sure — email copy:

Subject: Planned maintenance — Redwood hosted inference (2026-03-21 02:00 UTC)

Body: Hello — we're performing a planned upgrade to our hosted inference runtime on 2026-03-21 from 02:00-03:00 UTC. You may see brief increases in latency or short cold-starts for long-context requests. No data will be lost and automatic fallbacks are in place. If you rely on strict latency SLAs, consider pinning to a dedicated model/region during the window. Questions? Reply or contact support@redwood.ai.

Ayesha (oncall): approve for status page + email. add note to the status page that we'll update when canary completes.

Carla S: added: "Status updates will be posted at key milestones: canary complete, ramp start, and completed."

Support Bot: Draft saved as /comm-drafts/2026-03-21-runtime-upgrade.md. Would you like me to publish to status.redwood.ai now? (react :white_check_mark: to publish)

Liz Product: :white_check_mark: publishing now. Please keep an eye on canary dashboards.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-21 02:05 UTC, canary=10%. Telemetry: CPU +3%, p95 latency +640ms on canary. No errors so far.

Ayesha (oncall): watching metrics. If error rate >0.5% in 5m we rollback.

Carla S: capture rollback comms template in the thread in case we need quick send. Jonah, can you draft a rollback notice?

Jonah P: rollback template:

Subject: [Action Required] Incident — rollback of runtime upgrade

Body: We're rolling back a recent runtime upgrade for hosted inference (job-id=deploy-2026-03-21-02-00) due to elevated error rates. Impact: brief degraded availability for a small subset of requests while we revert. We're returning to previous stable runtime (v2.7.0). We'll post updates on status.redwood.ai and follow up with a post-incident summary. Contact support@redwood.ai for urgent questions.

Carla S: perfect. everyone OK with final text?

Liz Product: yep.

Ayesha (oncall): approved. standing by to trigger rollback if threshold hit.

Support Bot: Status page published. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-21-runtime-upgrade

Carla S: thanks team — I'll send the customer email now and pin this thread for quick reuse during the window.

Jonah P: quick note for follow-up: create a postmortem checklist item to capture observed p95 delta and whether prefix caching reduced cold starts.

Ayesha (oncall): noted. will add to incident tracker if we hit rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed at 2026-03-21 02:45 UTC. Canary -> full. No rollback triggered. Metrics: steady; p95 normalized after cache warmup.

Carla S: publishing post-rollout update to status page and sending closure email now. Thanks all. :tada:
